messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync — Q3 hosted roadmap handoff. We need to lock scope for Hosted API work across chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank. I put together a short tradeoffs doc draft but want alignment on launch criteria and owners. Here are the open questions: 
- Which customer asks are must-have vs nice-to-have?
- Concrete launch criteria for each surface (latency, cost, quality).
- Who drives canary/fallback policy for cross-model routing?

aj (Eng): I can own batching/quantization tradeoffs and the perf matrix. Need two things from product: representative load shapes + 5 test prompts per feature (chat/completions/embeds/rerank). @sanjay can you add quantization evals to the perf harness?

sanjay (ML): Yep. I'll run q4bits + int8-style configs and report delta on embedding cosine drift and chat BLEURT. Quick ask: what quality regression threshold do we accept (e.g., <=1.5% BLEURT drop)?

maria (PM): Proposal: embeddings: <=1% quality drop (cosine hit rate on core sets), cost -30% target; chat/completions: p50 latency target unchanged, p95 -20% improvement; reranker: maintain >95% baseline precision on our internal devset, p95 latency <150ms. Open to pushback.

emily (CS): From customer backlog: three enterprise accounts asked for deterministic embeddings + lower unit cost. They will accept small noise if docs show quantization tradeoffs. Also two product teams want reranker A/B in Q3.

oliver (Design): Need clarity on error states for degraded/regressed quality. For UI, we need a clear fallback state and copy if we switch model variants. Can we standardize a UX error taxonomy?

todd (Sales): Please prioritize embeddings cost. It's the gating blocker for 3 renewals. If we can promise ~30% unit cost reduction and a documented quality SLA, I can push renewals in July.

aj (Eng): For rollout options I'm leaning to: 1) canary traffic to quantized model for 5% 2) monitor cosine similarity and BLEURT 3) auto-fallback to full-precision model if regression crosses threshold. We should also have a time-based rollback TTL.

sanjay (ML): Agreed. I'll add the acceptance checks into the eval runner. Quick config snippet for the harness we can use: 

```
{
  "models": ["fp16-base","int8-q"],
  "checks": { "emb_cosine": 0.99, "chat_bleurt_drop": 1.0 },
  "traffic_canary_pct": 5
}
```

maria (PM): Nice. Two more operational asks: 
1) observability: per-route token cost and p95/p99 latency in the console for each variant.
2) rollout playbook: owner, SRE contact, fallback flows, and customer comms template.

aj (Eng): Observability is on scope but needs infra time. Can we split into M-V1 (basic metrics) and M-V2 (cost breakdown per token)? I'll estimate effort if product signs off on M-V1 only for initial launch.

emily (CS): For comms template — I can draft a short notice that explains expected changes and fallback behavior. Send me the rollout playbook draft and I'll adapt for customers.

maria (PM): Next steps and owners: 
- Tradeoffs doc + perf matrix: aj (lead) + sanjay (ML) - 2 weeks
- Canary + eval runner configs: sanjay - 10 days
- Observability M-V1: eng-infra sprint request (aj to scope)
- Rollout playbook + comms: maria + emily - 1 week
- UX fallback taxonomy: oliver - 1 week

product-bot: Reminder — roadmap sync meeting scheduled at 2026-07-08 16:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).

maria (PM): Can everyone drop any hard blockers or resource constraints in this thread by EOD Friday? I'll consolidate into the PRD and action list. :thumbsup:

aj (Eng): No blockers from infra but need 2 sprint slots for observability.

sanjay (ML): I might need GPU hours quota — will ask infra.

emily (CS): No blockers. Will prep the customer list for comms.

oliver (Design): UX slot booked next week.

todd (Sales): Renewal timing updated — pushing for July close if we hit the embedding cost target.

maria (PM): Great, thanks all. I'll post the tradeoffs doc link here once created.
